tasks.prompt:
Clear environment for child `Command`s

# Description
There is a bug when `hide-env` is used on environment variables that were present at shell startup. Namely, child processes still inherit the hidden environment variable. This PR fixes #12900, fixes #11495, and fixes #7937.

# Tests + Formatting
Added a test.

Investigation: Trace why hiding an environment variable present at shell startup still leaves it visible to an external child. Connect stack filtering, string conversion and process construction. Distinguish shell lookup tests from inherited-child regression.

gates.criterion: Explain get_env_vars hidden filtering; distinguish engine startup environment and stack values.
Connect env_to_strings to filtered stack environment while preserving conversion/errors.
Explain envs overlay versus inherited keys and clear-then-set intended environment.
Specify inherited-child hidden-variable, kept-variable and shell-only hide-env counterexamples.
